mapper.sql: id, collection_date, sector, collection_type, bin_color, note_fr, note_en, note_zh, source_url
mapper.select: select from collection_event where collection_date between #{startDate} and #{endDate} and (sector = #{sector} or sector = 'all') order by collection_date asc, collection_type asc
select from collection_event order by collection_date desc, collection_type asc
mapper.insert: insert into collection_event (collection_date, sector, collection_type, bin_color, note_fr, note_en, note_zh, source_url) values (#{collectionDate}, #{sector}, #{collectionType}, #{binColor}, #{noteFr}, #{noteEn}, #{noteZh}, #{sourceUrl})
mapper.update: update collection_event set collection_date = #{collectionDate}, sector = #{sector}, collection_type = #{collectionType}, bin_color = #{binColor}, note_fr = #{noteFr}, note_en = #{noteEn}, note_zh = #{noteZh}, source_url = #{sourceUrl} where id = #{id}
